title: Oxy Fast Relief Adult Nasal Spray

details.description: helps in providing effective relief from the blocked nose. It is a fast acting formula which starts to unblock the nose in 25 seconds. It helps in reducing excess nasal secretions and relives the swollen blood vessels. Otrivin Oxy Fast Relief provides a long lasting relief and acts upto 12 hours.

Otrivin Advance nasal decongestant spray provides instant relief from a blocked nose in just 1 spray. It starts to unblock a congested nose in 25 seconds. The spray is applied directly inside the nose, quickly opening up the nasal passages to help relieve congestion and allow you to breathe normally. Otrivin Advance continues to act for up to 12 hours2,4 - providing quick and long-lasting relief from nasal congestion. Otrivin Advance helps to open up the nasal passages by reducing any excessive nasal secretions and returning the swollen blood vessels to their normal size. This helps to quickly relieve a congested nose and allows for normal breathing.
details.usageInstructions:
Before first use, the pump should be sprayed several times into the air until an even spray is produced. If the spray has not been used for a few days or there is not an even spray, the initial process should be repeated. Using Otrivin Advance is easy and convenient. Just follow these simple steps:
1. Clear the nose.
2. Hold the bottle upright with the thumb under the base and nozzle between two fingers.
3. Lean your head forward slightly and insert the nozzle into a nostril.
4. Spray and breathe in gently through the nose at the same time.
5. Clean and dry the nozzle before replacing the cap right after use. To avoid the possible spread of infection, the product should only be used by one person. Be careful not to spray in the eyes. If the full spray is not administered, the dose should not be repeated.

details.description:
Otrivin Paediatric 0.05% w/v Nasal Spray is a kids usage product from the house of Otrivin, India’s biggest decongestant Nasal Spray. It is helpful in providing relief during nasal congestion. It gives relief from the feeling of blockage in the nose, starts working in 2 minutes and provides relief for up to 10 hours. It is recommended for kids above the age of 2 years and upto 11 years. Its key ingredient is Xylometazoline Hydrochloride solution, which comes with the below benefits.
Used in kids on the blocked nose due to cold
It is used to help the children avoid keeping his/her mouth open while sleeping, which may be due to a blocked nose
It helps in opening up the nasal passages by reducing excessive nasal secretions and returns the swollen blood vessels to their standard size
It acts quickly and provides long-lasting relief Otrivin Paediatric nasal solution is applied directly inside the nose.
details.usageInstructions:
Use as directed by the physician.
Store the formulation in a cool and dry place.
Read the label carefully before use.
Do not exceed the recommended dosage.
Keep out of the reach of children.
Make sure that when you’re using it on kids, it is only under adult supervision.

details.description:
Otrivin Saline comprises of purified salt solution. It is used to treat nasal congestion (blocked nose). It moisturizes and loosens the mucus inside of the nose and provides rapid relief from nasal congestion. Otrivin Saline works by moisturizing the inner surface of the nose. It helps in providing relief from stuffy nose due to common cold or allergies. This medicine is for external use only. You should use it in a dose and duration as advised by your doctor.
Before using this medicine, check the label. You have to tilt your head as far back as possible. Hold the dropper close to the nose. Make sure that you do not touch the nozzle. Squeeze the dropper gently so that the medicine gets placed in the nose. After few minutes, you can bend your head forward.
It is generally safe with little or no side effects. However, it might cause nasal irritation at the time of application. Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you are on any medication or are allergic to this medication. Also, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Please consult your doctor, if you miss any dose.Composition:
Sodium Chloride (0.74%w/v)
details.usageInstructions: Use this medicine in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor. Check the label for directions before use. Insert the bottle tip into one nostril and close the other nostril. Direct the spray towards the sides of your nostril, away from the cartilage dividing the two sides of your nose. As you spray, breath gently and keep the head upright. Repeat the same process for the other nostrils.

details.description: Breathe easy and say goodbye to air pollution and allergies with Otrivin Breathe Clean Nasal Wash. This natural solution gently cleanses and soothes your nose, effectively washing away pollutants, germs, and excess particles like dust and pollen. Formulated with an isotonic sea salt solution and natural glycerin, it helps moisturise and soothe the nasal passage, making breathing easier during colds or allergic conditions. Suitable for daily use for all ages 2 years and above, the product comes in a 100 ml can with an aerosol spray for greater coverage of the nasal area. Cleans and moisturises naturally, washes away pollutants, and makes breathing easier - Otrivin Breathe Clean is the natural way to keep your nose healthy and your breathing clear.
details.usageInstructions:
Blow the nose, prime the spray once, insert the nozzle in the hose, tilt at an angle and spray briefly.
Do the same for the other nostril. Blow the nose after usage.
Wash the nozzle with warm water after use and put the overlap back on.
Store in a cool and dry place and keep away from the reach of children.
Do not share the can. It is for single person use only.
